question: How should the preferences of younger investors shape Edward Jones's offerings?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Edward Jones is developing a new digital platform focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors.
items.quote: a new digital platform, focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors

items.text: Edward Jones announced it has taken a minority stake in the personal finance app Quicken, intending the investment as a step toward integrating Quicken's personal financial management capabilities more directly into Edward Jones to support its value proposition and advisor conversations with clients.
items.quote: Edward Jones announced that they have taken a minority stake in the personal finance app Quicken, with an explicit intention that the investment is a step towards integrating Quicken's personal financial management capabilities more directly into Edward Jones as a way to support their value proposition and advisor conversations with clients.

items.text: Edward Jones offers Financial Planning Services, where clients receive a more personalized experience with additional planning capabilities.
items.quote: recently launched products and solutions such as Financial Planning Services, where clients receive a more personalized experience with additional planning capabilities

items.text: Edward Jones targets new clients through the High Net Worth initiative and a new digital platform focused on Next Generation investors, and through Workplace which connects business owners and employees with financial solutions.
items.quote: These initiatives also include targeting new clients: High Net Worth... Workplace, which connects local business owners and their employees with financial solutions through their workplace; and a new digital platform, focused on attracting and retaining Next Generation investors.

items.text: Edward Jones is partnering with Aboon and Retirement Plan Advisory Group to develop an end-to-end retirement plan management tool, leveraging an AI-native platform.
items.quote: Edward Jones has partnered with Aboon, an AI-driven third-party administrator, and Retirement Plan Advisory Group (part of Great Gray Group) to develop an end-to-end retirement plan management tool.

items.text: Edward Jones's Digital and Data division supports investment in technology infrastructure and digital initiatives to provide new tools for branch teams and create operational efficiencies; branch teams leverage new tools for deeper discovery conversations and more comprehensive advice and planning.
items.quote: The Partnership's Digital and Data division supports the significant investment in technology infrastructure and digital initiatives to provide new tools for branch teams to better serve clients... Branch teams leverage new tools for deeper discovery conversations with clients and more comprehensive advice and planning.

items.text: Edward Jones notes changing client expectations for expanded product offerings and technology needs and changing client demographics, preferences and values tied to generational wealth transfer as factors affecting its ability to compete.
items.quote: changing client expectations for expanded product offerings and technology needs, and changing client demographics, preferences and values

cells.reason: The passages describe Edward Jones's digital platform for Next Gen investors, the Quicken stake, and other tech initiatives directly related to younger investors' preferences.
